about: Coordinates are WGS84 decimal degrees. 'outline' is a simplified border polygon in GeoJSON [lon, lat] order. Leaders change: verify before teaching. government_system is one of presidential_republic, parliamentary_republic, constitutional_monarchy, absolute_monarchy. Flags: assets/flags/<iso2>.svg.

pins.name: Aconcagua
pins.description: Highest mountain in the Americas and outside Asia.

pins.name: Ojos del Salado
pins.description: The highest volcano on Earth, on the border with Chile.

notes.text: The name Argentina comes from the Latin word 'argentum', meaning silver.
Ushuaia, in Tierra del Fuego, is often called the southernmost city in the world.
Gauchos are the cowboys of the Pampas, famous for horse riding and sharing mate tea.

pins.name: Mount Fuji
pins.description: Japan's tallest peak; it last erupted in 1707.

pins.name: Sakurajima
pins.description: One of the most active volcanoes in Japan.

pins.name: Mount Kita
pins.description: Second-highest mountain in Japan, in the Southern Alps.

notes.text: Japan is made of more than 14,000 islands.
Japanese people call their country 'Nihon' or 'Nippon', meaning 'origin of the sun'.
Children fly carp-shaped streamers called koinobori on Children's Day, 5 May.

pins.name: Mount Catherine
pins.description: Egypt's highest mountain, in the Sinai Peninsula.

pins.name: Mount Sinai
pins.description: Famous peak climbed at night to watch the sunrise.

pins.name: Qattara Depression
pins.description: A huge desert basin far below sea level.

notes.text: The Great Pyramid of Giza was the tallest human-made structure for about 3,800 years.
Almost everyone in Egypt lives close to the Nile, which flows north into the Mediterranean.
Ancient Egyptians wrote with hieroglyphs, a script of more than 700 picture signs.

pins.name: Teide
pins.description: Spain's highest peak, a volcano on the island of Tenerife.

pins.name: Mulhacén
pins.description: Highest mountain on the Iberian Peninsula, in the Sierra Nevada.

pins.name: Aneto
pins.description: The tallest summit of the Pyrenees.

notes.text: Spanish is the second most spoken native language in the world.
Madrid sits almost exactly in the centre of the Iberian Peninsula.
In Buñol, people throw tomatoes at each other every August during La Tomatina.

pins.name: Hvannadalshnúkur
pins.description: Iceland's highest point, on the rim of the Öræfajökull volcano.

pins.name: Hekla
pins.description: Once called the 'Gateway to Hell' in medieval legends.

pins.name: Eyjafjallajökull
pins.description: Its 2010 ash cloud grounded flights across Europe.

notes.text: Iceland sits on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, where two tectonic plates pull apart.
Iceland's parliament, the Althing, was founded in 930 and is one of the oldest in the world.
Many Icelanders grow up with tales of huldufólk, the 'hidden people' who live in rocks.
